name: Aston University

settingEvidence.evidence: Our campus is based in the centre of Birmingham, the youngest major city in Europe and a great place to live, work and study.

fees.text: £10,050 per year for UK (Home) students starting in 2027/28. Aston's course pages say this is expected and subject to parliamentary approval, and that fees will then rise each year in line with inflation (the 2028/29 fee is not published). The placement year is charged at £1,250 (a figure Aston gives for 2026 entry).

livingCosts.text: On-campus ensuite halls (run with Unite Students) cost £170 a week (7-bed flat) to £182 a week (5-bed flat) for September 2027 starters on 44-week contracts, with all bills (except a TV Licence) and Wi-Fi included. There is no deposit, but a £250 advance fee is deducted from your first rent payment.

source.evidence: Available for £170.00 per week, with 44-week contracts available.

openDays.text: Next undergraduate open day: Saturday 28 November 2026, 9am to 3pm (Aston's last of 2026). 2027 dates aren't announced yet. There is also an online Virtual Open Day.

contextual.summary: UK (Home) fee students from state schools who meet any one of Aston's criteria can get a lower 'Aston Ready' offer, assessed automatically when they apply.
contextual.typicalReduction: One or two grades lower than the standard offer (for example, ABB becomes BBB).

criteria.detail: Eligible for free school meals by the end of key stage 4, within the last 6 years (Aston gets this from UCAS' Modernised Contextual Data Service).
Live in a low participation neighbourhood: POLAR 4 quintile 1 or 2.
Declared a disability (Aston uses the information on your UCAS form).

Completed an Aston Pathways programme during Year 12 and 13 (email the Pathway Team with your UCAS number when you apply). Aston's Pathways to the Professions programmes cover Medicine, Healthcare and Engineering and Technology (STEM).
Studying at a school in the Aston University STEM Education Academy Trust: Aston University Engineering Academy, Aston University Maths School or Aston University Goldsmith's Institute.
Spent time in local authority care (declare that you are a care leaver on your UCAS form; your referee is normally expected to confirm).
Granted refugee status by the Home Office.

contextual.rulesText: To receive a contextual offer you must have attended a state school and be assessed as a Home student for fee purposes, and meet one of the listed criteria. Typically the Aston Ready offer is one or two grades lower than the standard offer. It is assessed at the point of application (no extra forms), except that Pathways completers must email the Pathway Team with their UCAS number. It does not apply to the Business and Social Sciences Foundation Year.

source.evidence: Our contextual offer scheme could reduce your undergraduate offer by one or two grades.

notes: All Aston course pages checked on 2026-10-21 show a September 2027 start and there are no 2028-entry pages yet (a September 2028 course URL returns 404), so every course uses 2027 entry.

Most Aston economics, finance and business degrees are 4-year courses with an integrated placement year. It is compulsory for UK (Home) students; international students can ask to opt out. Studying abroad is an alternative to a work placement.
Aston is not on UAT-UK's 2027-entry list of courses needing the TMUA or another UAT-UK test, and no Aston course page mentions an admissions test.

Foundation Programmes (A level entry CCC) exist for Economics (L10F), Business Economics (LN1F), Finance (N30F) and Accounting and Finance (N42F), and there is a Mathematics with Economics Foundation Programme. The first four also let you progress to other Aston Business School degrees (you still need the GCSE requirements).

Aston's Pathways to the Professions (Year 12 access programmes) are for Medicine, Healthcare and Engineering and Technology (STEM) only, so none is recorded as an Economics programme; completing one still counts as an Aston Ready contextual criterion. Schools can book KS5 Campus Experience Days that include Economics and Business subject tasters (not open to individual sign-up).
Aston is a compact single-site campus in the centre of Birmingham, with on-campus halls run with Unite Students.
